properties.name: --noesis-secondary-text
properties.description: Secondary text: quieter than the body text, a step more contrast than Mantine's dimmed. Gray 7 in light, dark 1 in dark, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-rail-background
properties.description: The ground of the app's navigation, the top bar and the rail: a tint off the page. Gray 1 in light, dark 8 in dark, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-rail-border
properties.description: The line that rules the top bar and the rail off from the page, and outlines what is raised on the rail. Gray 2 in light, dark 5 in dark, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-rail-surface
properties.description: What is raised on the rail: the change's card and the item you are on. White in light, dark 7 in dark, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-brand-mark
properties.description: The Noesis mark's colour, from the brand book: navy #2B2D3C in light, cyan #7EE3E8 in dark, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-focus-ring
properties.description: The outline a control takes under the keyboard (`:focus-visible`), in the brand filled colour; each rule sets its own offset. from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-architecture-edge
properties.description: Lines and borders of the architecture diagram: its edges and adapter cards. Gray 6 / dark 2, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-card
properties.description: A card on any diagram, the exploration's and the architecture's. White / dark 6 (a grey over its darkened frame), from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-card-border
properties.description: A diagram card's hairline. Gray 3 / dark 4, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-card-border-hover
properties.description: A diagram card's hairline under the pointer. Gray 4 / dark 3, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-card-radius
properties.description: A diagram card's corners: 12px (DIAGRAM_SHAPE), from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-frame-radius
properties.description: A diagram frame's corners, rounder than a card's: 16px (DIAGRAM_SHAPE), from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-bevel
properties.description: How far a value object's corners are cut: 12px (DIAGRAM_SHAPE), from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-card-shadow
properties.description: A diagram card's lift off the canvas, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-card-shadow-raised
properties.description: A diagram card's lift under the pointer, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-dimmed
properties.description: The opacity a card or frame steps back to while something else is in hand: 0.3, on every diagram, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-edge-dimmed
properties.description: The opacity a line steps back to while something else is in hand: 0.2, on every diagram, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-module
properties.description: A module's frame on a diagram: the exploration's container, the architecture's hexagon. Brand 0 at 40% / dark 9 at 30% (see-through, so a frame inside another is darker), from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-module-border
properties.description: A module frame's edge. Brand 2 / `--mantine-color-brand-light-color` (brand 2), from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-block
properties.description: A building block's frame, or the architecture's domain core. Brand 0 at 60% / dark 9 at 30%, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-block-border
properties.description: A building block frame's edge. Brand 2 / dark 2, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-external
properties.description: What a diagram has not designed: a caller, an adapter. White / dark 4, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-selection-ring
properties.description: The ring round the selected element on a diagram. Brand 1 / `--mantine-color-brand-light-color` at 25%, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-related
properties.description: The dashed outline of what relates to the selection on a diagram. Brand 3 / `--mantine-color-brand-light-color` at 70%, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-highlight
properties.description: The selection's own relations on a diagram. Brand 6 / `--mantine-color-brand-light-color`, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-selection
properties.description: What marks the selected element on a diagram. Brand 5 / `--mantine-color-brand-light-color` (brand 2), from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-edge-uses
properties.description: The line and arrow of a relation one element uses on the exploration. Brand 4 / #5a7aa3, from `relationEdges` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-edge-uses-word
properties.description: The word on a uses line. Brand 9 / brand 2, from `relationEdges` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-edge-invokes
properties.description: The line and arrow of a relation one element invokes on the exploration. Violet 6 / violet 2, from `relationEdges` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-edge-invokes-word
properties.description: The word on an invokes line. Violet 6 / violet 2, from `relationEdges` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-edge-uses-dash
properties.description: The length of a uses line's dash when the edges run: 3px, from `relationEdges` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-edge-uses-gap
properties.description: The gap between a uses line's dashes: 4px, from `relationEdges` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-edge-uses-time
properties.description: The time a uses line's dash and gap take to move one length along: 0.7s, from `relationEdges` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-edge-invokes-dash
properties.description: The length of a invokes line's dash when the edges run: 10px, from `relationEdges` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-edge-invokes-gap
properties.description: The gap between a invokes line's dashes: 5px, from `relationEdges` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-edge-invokes-time
properties.description: The time a invokes line's dash and gap take to move one length along: 0.35s, from `relationEdges` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-edge-label
properties.description: The pill a relation's word sits on. White / dark 7, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-edge-label-border
properties.description: The pill's hairline. Gray 3 / dark 4, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-edge-highlight-label
properties.description: The pill of one of the selection's own relations. Brand 0 / dark 6, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-edge-highlight-label-border
properties.description: That pill's hairline. Brand 3 / brand 2 at 70%, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-edge-highlight-word
properties.description: The word on one of the selection's own relations. Brand 7 / brand 2, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-requirement-quote
properties.description: Background of a quoted need or rule statement in the requirements view. Gray 0 / dark 6, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-requirement-gap
properties.description: Text and underline of a gap in the requirements view — a need no rule traces to. Red 8 / red 4, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.
